definitions.explanation: A barrier constructed to hold back water and create a reservoir.

examples.english: They build a dam in the mountains.

notes:
From English "dam." Refers to a barrier built across a river to hold back water, creating a reservoir ({貯水池|ちょすいち}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ダムを{建設|けんせつ}する: to construct a dam
- ダムの{放流|ほうりゅう}: water release from a dam
- ダム{湖|こ}: reservoir, dam lake
- {水力|すいりょく}ダム: hydroelectric dam
- {多目的|たもくてき}ダム: multipurpose dam

IN JAPAN:
Dams serve multiple purposes: {水道|すいどう} (water supply), {治水|ちすい} (flood control), and {発電|はつでん} (power generation). Famous dams include {黒部|くろべ}ダム in {富山県|とやまけん}. Dam tourism (ダム{巡|めぐ}り) has become a popular hobby, with collectible "dam cards" ({放流|ほうりゅう}カード) available at many sites.
